test_title: PYST 9: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 01 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A and B working together can do a piece of work in 3 days. B alone can do the same work in 21 days. How long (in days) will A alone take to do double the work?
solution:
**Given:**

(A + B) = 3 days

B = 21 days

**Formula used:**

Total work = LCM of time

Efficiency = Work / Time

**Calculations:**

Total work = LCM(3, 21) = 21 units

⇒ Efficiency (A + B) = 21 / 3 = 7

⇒ Efficiency (B) = 21 / 21 = 1

⇒ Efficiency (A) = 7 - 1 = 6

⇒ Double work = 21 × 2 = 42 units

⇒ Time taken by A alone = (42)/(6) = 7 days

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
